is.one_liner: Sovereign asset surface — storage layout + static-asset CDN + NFT metadata serving + retrieval API
scope: Define the StorageAdapter abstraction + URL contract over S3, IPFS, Arweave, and local stores
Serve static assets (NFT metadata, music, archetype images) via CDN
Own per-pattern storage layouts (NFT collection, per-world music, per-Door asset bundles)

is_not: Does NOT own per-collection content — it owns the storage abstraction, not the bytes' meaning
Will NOT be a cloud provider — it wraps S3/IPFS/Arweave behind one interface
Does NOT model a filesystem hierarchy — it is object + CDN storage
